message.subject: SH-220 – counterproposal for 24-month award
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for the straightforward quotation. The competing quotation offer:DEMO-C1-0 is €16.00 per unit, so we need a stronger package to award SH-220 to you.
For 6,000 units annually over 24 months, please consider these alternatives:
A: €12.00/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW.
B: €12.50/unit, 30 days net, 35-day lead time, DAP.
C: €13.00/unit, 60 days net, 28-day lead time, DAP.
We can trade faster payment and a longer production window for price. Which package works best for your shop? Please share your cost breakdown if these levels need adjustment.
Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

message.subject: SH-220 – price and delivery counterproposal
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for your proposal. We are comparing complete packages for 6,000 units annually over 24 months. Delivery must be within 35 days for our production requirement; please confirm your achievable lead time explicitly.
Please consider these alternatives:
A: €12.00/unit, 60 days net, 35-day lead time, DAP.
B: €12.50/unit, 45 days net, 35-day lead time, FCA.
C: €13.00/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW.
The early-payment option is intended to support your cash flow. Please identify the most competitive workable package and explain any freight or scheduling constraint.
Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Negotiate both rather than accept J opening; C opening fails lead time. Deep anchors plus cash/freight alternatives probe economics; J rival evidence may unlock approval.

trace.final_text: Counterproposals sent to both suppliers, with alternative payment, freight, and delivery packages.

message.subject: PH-100 – two-year commitment and revised pricing
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

We value our twelve-year partnership and want a sustainable arrangement for your foundry. In return for a 24-month commitment at 4,000 housings annually, please consider these alternatives, each with the new price effective 1 April 2027 and the existing price retained until then:

A: EUR 46.14 per housing, payment 60 days net.
B: EUR 45.95 per housing, payment 45 days net.
C: EUR 45.77 per housing, payment 30 days net.

All three retain FCA and the 35-day lead time. These are opening proposals for a longer commitment, rather than a request to compromise supply stability. Please share your current full manufacturing cost per housing, including overhead, and the energy and wage changes behind the requested increase. If these levels cannot support a healthy margin, please return your closest sustainable package and explain the gap.

Kind regards,
Lead Buyer
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Compare existing acceptance at EUR448810.67 with moderate asks costing EUR391059–400320 and deeper opening packages near EUR382000. The supplier typically closes a share of the first gap and rewards a longer commitment; choose a deep opening while requesting full costs before settling sustainable pricing. No priced alternative exists.

trace.final_text: Sent three two-year proposals and requested a cost breakdown to establish sustainable pricing.

message.subject: SH-220 – revised early-payment packages
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for confirming the 35-day production lead time. We do not require overtime or a shorter schedule.
We can retain your preferred 14-day payment and increase our price proposal. Please consider either €13.20/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW; or €13.80/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, DAP.
Both cover 6,000 units annually over 24 months. Please review the price with your management if needed; we are making a payment concession and need a more competitive price for the award.
Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: C's first reply improved versus historical pattern and prefers cash. Continue with modest price move on selected cash structure and DAP alternative; acceptance too early while J response pending. Revise if no price movement or freight premium exceeds alternative.

trace.final_text: Revised early-payment proposals sent to Demo Machining.

message.subject: PH-100 – revised two-year proposal
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for accepting the two-year term and April start date. Our volume basis is our purchasing requirement of 4,000 PH-100 housings per year for the next two years, not an assumed increase in demand. We can carry that annual quantity into the agreement.

I respect that your detailed costs and margin are confidential. In recognition of your movement, we increase our proposal to EUR 47.00 per housing, payment 30 days net, a 24-month contract, effective 1 April 2027. The current price remains in place until that date; FCA and the 35-day lead time remain unchanged.

The longer commitment and 30-day payment are intended to support your planning and cash flow. Please review what further price movement this package permits while protecting reliable supply.

Kind regards,
Lead Buyer
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: The supplier's 39% first-gap closure matches its own records. Compare EUR47, 48 and49.20 evaluated asks with acceptance at422491.09; choose47 to preserve negotiation runway while moving materially from45.77 at supplier-preferred30-day terms. Provisional cost estimate uncertain because costs are confidential; commercial ask is390242.45 and total402807.24. No deal has no alternative.

trace.final_text: Sent a revised €47.00 proposal, retaining 30-day payment and the two-year commitment.

message.subject: SH-220 – revised proposal for internal review
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for the movement and the breakdown. We will retain 14-day payment and the 35-day production window; no faster delivery is needed.
I can improve our proposal to €12.30/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW. Alternatively, we offer €12.90/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, DAP.
Please take these revised packages into your internal price review and return your best workable terms for 6,000 units annually over 24 months. We appreciate the practical approach and would like to close the remaining gap.
Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Small concession preserves large gap for J's internal approval and remaining 2-4 responses. Alternative 13 EXW costs more and weakens anchor. Accepting 190780 now worse than likely further reduction; no walk-away while competitive bids live.

trace.final_text: Revised EXW and DAP proposals sent to Demo Drehteile for its internal price review.

message.subject: PH-100 – narrowing the price gap
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the further reduction. We are making another move towards you: EUR 47.70 per housing, payment 30 days net, a 24-month contract, with the price effective 1 April 2027. The existing price applies until then, with FCA and the 35-day lead time unchanged.

We retain the 4,000-unit annual commitment and your preferred payment terms. Please take this improved proposal back through your review and return the closest price you can support on that basis. We want to resolve the remaining gap without weakening our long-term supply partnership.

Kind regards,
Lead Buyer
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Compared47.70/30,48.10/30 and48.60/60, plus accepting418460.01 or no-deal. Actual supplier moves reflect commercial rather than uncertain inferred relationship costs:47.70 makes a clear price concession and preserves room for remaining replies. Choose it to retain gap-driven supplier reductions; revise if supplier declares final or refuses further movement.

trace.final_text: Sent an improved €47.70 proposal while preserving the agreed contract structure.

message.subject: SH-220 – management review of competitive price
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Please proceed with your management review. The competing offer offer:DEMO-J1-1 is €15.10/unit with 14-day payment, 35-day lead time and EXW delivery, below your equivalent EXW quotation.
We can make a further small move to €13.30/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW; alternatively €13.90/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, DAP.
Please obtain approval for your strongest price on this 6,000-unit annual, 24-month award. We have retained your preferred payment terms; the next step needs to be on your price rather than another freight adjustment.
Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: C held price after large concession; now use verified lower rival for approval and only small reciprocal step. Larger ask concession 14.5 yields worse probable end price; neither current acceptance nor walk-away competitive while J negotiating.

trace.final_text: Sent a small revised offer and requested management approval, citing the lower competing quotation.

message.subject: PH-100 – further movement on our proposal
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for continuing to work towards an agreement. We can now move to EUR 48.00 per housing, payment 30 days net, a 24-month contract, effective 1 April 2027. The current price remains applicable beforehand. FCA, 35-day lead time and the annual quantity of 4,000 housings remain unchanged.

This is a further price concession while retaining the planning security and prompt payment you requested. Please consider a corresponding improvement from your side; we would like to settle the price on a basis that both companies can sustain.

Kind regards,
Lead Buyer
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Compared48/30,48.30/30,48.70/60 with immediate acceptance415772.62 and no-deal. Choose incremental48/30: supplier continues 11–13% commercial-gap moves and has not declared final. Alternative longer payment offers no clear supplier advantage. Keep next price concession available for expected final at fifth reply.

trace.final_text: Sent a €48.00 counteroffer, retaining 30-day payment and the April 2027 start date.

message.subject: PH-100 – revised price for the agreed framework
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

We appreciate your further concession and the continuity your foundry provides. To narrow the gap again, we improve our proposal to EUR 48.25 per housing, payment 30 days net, a 24-month contract, effective 1 April 2027. The current price remains in force before that date; FCA, the 35-day lead time and 4,000 housings annually remain unchanged.

We are keeping the framework stable rather than asking you to trade away payment or volume security. Please review the remaining price gap once more and send the best sustainable offer you can make within this framework.

Kind regards,
Lead Buyer
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Compared evaluated48.25/30,48.60/30,49/45 with signing413757.08 or no deal. Choose48.25 concession to preserve a meaningful commercial gap; supplier's decreasing gap-driven steps imply about411895 next, probably final. Retain a substantive closing concession for a final offer, where its own record supports agreement after buyer movement.

message.subject: SH-220 – final commercial structure
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for completing the review. I respect your final price position.
Before award, could you accommodate €14.25/unit, 60 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW; or €14.85/unit, 60 days net, 35-day lead time, DAP? These alternatives increase the unit price in exchange for longer payment.
If neither works, please issue your stated EXW alternative as the firm offer: €14.20/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW, for 6,000 units annually over 24 months. We can arrange collection and do not need faster production.
Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: J final supersedes predicted reply runway. No deeper price pressure; seek better payment structure with price compensation and exact stated EXW fallback, making alternative signable. C pending but unlikely to beat J. Accept next if structure holds.

trace.final_text: Sent a €48.25 proposal and requested the supplier’s best sustainable offer on the agreed framework.
Requested a final payment-structure adjustment, with the supplier’s stated EXW terms as the fallback.

message.subject: SH-220 – closing comparison
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for securing approval. I understand this is your final position.
The competing firm offer offer:DEMO-J1-3 is €14.80/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, DAP, so your current package is not competitive for this award.
To give you one closing opportunity, we can increase our proposal to €14.70/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, DAP; alternatively €14.10/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW. If you cannot accommodate either, we respect your decision and will conclude our comparison on the offers available.
Kind regards,
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: C final substantially worse than J. One closing rival-backed concession might unlock a competitive quote; do not accept C. Await J's requested final structure rather than prematurely accepting its former sheet.

trace.final_text: Sent Demo Machining a closing proposal against the lower firm competing offer.

message.subject: PH-100 – closing proposal for confirmation
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your final offer. I recognise the concessions you have made and do not want to prolong the exchange unnecessarily. To bring this to a conclusion, we can make a larger closing move to EUR 49.10 per housing, payment 30 days net, a 24-month contract, effective 1 April 2027.

This recognises an increase over our current price while retaining your requested payment terms and the commitment to 4,000 housings annually. The current price remains applicable until 1 April 2027; FCA and the 35-day lead time remain unchanged.

If you can confirm this complete package in your offer, we are ready to proceed with the agreement. We would be pleased to continue the partnership on that basis.

Kind regards,
Lead Buyer
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Compare immediate final acceptance412413.39 with closing asks48.80,49.10,49.40. Choose49.10: material0.85 concession from prior ask and estimated sustainable margin without relationship charge; its own post-final record agreed in8 moving-buyer cases versus walking after unmoved demands.49.10 approximates its best recorded package cost and balances improvement with closing likelihood. If refused, do not repeat unmoved demand; accept or materially revise.

trace.final_text: Sent a €49.10 closing proposal with a larger concession and readiness to sign upon confirmation.
Accepted Demo Drehteile’s offer: €14.20/unit, 14 days net, 35-day lead time, EXW, for 24 months.

message.subject: PH-100 – final reconciliation of the price gap
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the exceptional concession. We recognise your position and remain committed to concluding the two-year agreement with your foundry.

I have reviewed the remaining gap and can improve our closing proposal again, to EUR 49.50 per housing, payment 30 days net, a 24-month contract, effective 1 April 2027. The current price applies until then, with FCA, the 35-day lead time and 4,000 housings annually unchanged.

Would you confirm this package so we can proceed to signature? This is a genuine further move on our side, not a request to repeat the earlier proposal. If it cannot be supported, please keep your current offer available for our decision; we do not intend this as an ultimatum.

Kind regards,
Lead Buyer
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Compared signing411741.55,49.50/30 at407038.62,49.80/30 at409054.16 and50.20/60 at409078.36. Actual thread diverged from immediate postfinal agreement but still conceded. Closest supplier record distinguishes moved asks(all8 agreed) from unmoved demands(walked6); choose another genuine0.40 concession keeping preferred30-day cash terms, explicit non-ultimatum and request to preserve standing offer. Avoid further negotiation if it refuses.

trace.final_text: Sent a €49.50 closing proposal, explicitly preserving the supplier’s current offer if declined.
Accepted €49.90 per housing, 30-day payment, and a 24-month contract effective 1 April 2027; total evaluated cost: €409,726.01.
